text:
Type: small floating wall shelf
Use: displaying a plant, small speaker or keepsakes; living room, bedroom, hallway, home office
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: black-brown foil-finished board with concealed mounting
Colors: dark black-brown, near black
Shape: thick solid-looking block with square edges and hidden fixings so it seems to float, simple cuboid, compact but chunky
Feel: graphic, bold, tidy, modern
Goes with: white or light grey walls, light wood, brass or white decor; minimalist or modern rooms

product.name: LACK
product.description: The shelf becomes one with the wall thanks to the concealed mounting hardware.
